commands.name: search
commands.description: Find components, foundations, and production UI patterns by name or tag.

commands.name: component
commands.description: Return one component contract with source, evidence, imports, and governance metadata.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check whether a component has enough evidence for production recommendation.

commands.name: template
commands.description: Return governed page or workflow templates once template contracts exist.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Run dry-run codemods for breaking component API migrations.

rules.importPolicy: Use @nebutra/ui package imports inside Nebutra apps; use registry URLs only for standalone consumers.
rules.registryPolicy: Registry manifests are distribution adapters and must not become internal design authority.
rules.tokenPolicy: @nebutra/tokens owns runtime CSS variables; components consume tokens and do not redefine them.
